title: An Affordable Late-Night Cafe on the Bangalore–Mysore Highway: About ₹800 for Two
description: Looking for a budget-friendly cafe near Bangalore? Fernway by Stories on the Bangalore–Mysore highway costs about ₹800 for two, with garden seating, live music and food till 6am.
imageAlt: Garden gazebo table for two at Fernway by Stories in Mayaganahalli
keywords: affordable restaurants on Bangalore Mysore highway
cafes under 1000 for two near Bangalore
cheap late night food near Bangalore

sections.heading: A garden night out that doesn't cost a fortune
paragraphs: Open-air garden seating, candlelit tables and live music usually come with a big bill. At Fernway by Stories, a meal for two costs about ₹800 — so a date night, a road-trip lunch or a late-night meal with friends stays easy on the wallet.

sections.heading: What ₹800 for two gets you
paragraphs: Our menu runs from quick bites to full meals, so you can keep it light or go all in:
list: Soups, salads, chaat and small bites for sharing
Tikkas from the clay oven, including our chatpata chicken tikka
North Indian curries with fresh Indian breads, biryanis, fried rice and noodles
Pizzas, pastas, burgers, sushi and dumplings
Coffee, cold brews, frappes and desserts

sections.heading: Candlelight and live music
paragraphs: Candlelit garden tables are there every night. On weekends, {{fridayJam}}, and {{saturdayBand}} — good food and music under the open sky.

sections.heading: Find us
paragraphs: We're in Mayaganahalli on the Bangalore–Mysore highway, between Bidadi and Ramanagara, open every day from {{hoursDisplay}}. Address: {{address}}. Book a table online or call {{phone}}.
